'''Grass Trekkers''' were a [[Sentience|semi-sentient]] race native to the [[forest]] [[moon]] of [[Endor]]. They were aggressive and skilled [[hunter]]s.<ref name="BMF 38" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Grass Trekkers were mentioned in the article  "Sentient Species of Endor," published in the "[[Guide to the Galaxy]]" section of the magazine [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 38|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 38]], which was published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="BMF 38" /> on [[September 23]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|38}}</ref> The [[Grass Trekker/Legends|race]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where they first appeared in "[[The Land of the Gupins]]," the eighth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]] of the television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']],<ref name="Ewoks">{{Ewoks|The Land of the Gupins}}</ref> which aired on [[October 26]], [[1985]]<ref name="This Week Carpet">{{ThisWeek|dTR7q_0_YOQ|The Mandalorian Virtual Red Carpet Premiere, What Scares the Jedi, and More!|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-virtual-red-carpet-premiere-what-scares-the-jedi-and-more}}</ref>
